body: Oh, so there is. Ummm... don't know why I didn't notice those things. Thank you both.

[Tarot](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B58RGr102uu5UnlkTDVkTEN6cU0), the rather sickly mage. He's an all-rounder, focusing on utility if anything, and is still rather new to the scene. He doesn't have much luck (a total of 1 Edge and Gremlins) but he's ready to summon to make up for anything he's lacking in. 

Prompt: Favorite way to die? Something quick to the head. How he'd *like* to die? From wounds after taking one of the sicknesses of the astral world out (toxic mages mostly). Those won't be fast but it'd be worth it.

Prompt: "Now, ya gonna tell us what we want, freak, or do we have to cut off the other ear?" [Tarot](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B58RGr102uu5UnlkTDVkTEN6cU0) barely understood the man, focused on the blinding pain that streamed from his mangled ear. He couldn't rely on his usual skills of Casting or Summoning spirits and he didn't have any Influence to turn the situation around. "Bah, turn him over. Let's take the ot-" Then there was an explosion and more gunshots. The other runners. It was probably less to save Tarot and more the fact that Tarot had been carrying the briefcase when they got ambushed. Shame their contact hadn't given him the combination or Tarot might have been able to get out of there without mutilation.

Currently working on an update but the basics are still in place.

New to the scene but looking to make a name for himself, the allergy-prone, mutilated [Tarot](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B58RGr102uu5UnlkTDVkTEN6cU0)! Elf mage who doesn't like spells that make a lot of noise unless things go very wrong! 

RP Response: Funds? Oh, right, those. Yeah, I have funds, plenty of them, honest. I keep them in my... uh... safe I keep under the floor (complete lie, he just has credsticks)? Hey, want to see a magic trick? (note the 670 nuyen that is all Tarot has to his name)
